lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 thin, high-contrast vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section (approx. 40-50 pixels) and becomes more irregular and faint towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the posterior region terminate mid-flank or appear as broken, dashed segments before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 2-3 distinct white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank near the junction of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior flank show a near-horizontal linear alignment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory, curving posterodorsally from the base before twisting inward and upward at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of the cranial base across the horn pedicles.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15-20% of the total horn length from the apex downward.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the torso and forelimb; prominent white dorsal crest; high-contrast yellow-orange coloration on lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
